items.title: 4th APEC Silicon Valley Summit Concludes in Hong Kong, Empowering Asia-Pacific Collaboration
items.excerpt: Co-hosted by the Bay Area Council and MEBO International, the 'Silicon Valley Meets APEC: Bay to Bay' forum in Hong Kong brought together business, technology, and policy leaders — alongside a CGI-MEBO healthcare innovation dinner attended by Chelsea Clinton.
items.image_alt: 4th APEC Silicon Valley Summit Concludes in Hong Kong, Empowering Asia-Pacific Collaboration

items.title: MEBO International at Hospitalar 2026 Brazil: Expanding Regenerative Medical Technology into Latin America
items.excerpt: MEBO International debuted Regenerative Medical Technology at Hospitalar 2026 in São Paulo, drawing distributors and wound care professionals from eight Latin American countries.
items.image_alt: MEBO International at Hospitalar 2026 Brazil: Expanding Regenerative Medical Technology into Latin America

items.title: MEBO International Continues to Promote Regional Medical Exchanges, Focusing on Silver Healing
items.excerpt: The second 2026 session of the Latin America Regenerative Medical Technology Seminar series focused on regenerative treatment of elderly wounds, aligning with the 'Silver Healing' initiative co-launched with the Clinton Foundation.
items.image_alt: MEBO International Continues to Promote Regional Medical Exchanges, Focusing on Silver Healing

items.title: Regenerative Medical Technology Empowers Burn Care: MEBO International Shines at the 2026 ABA Orlando Conference
items.excerpt: At the 58th American Burn Association Annual Meeting, MEBO International presented its full-process wound care solutions, debuted its APEC collaboration achievements, and heard encouraging FDA clinical trial updates from UC Davis.
items.image_alt: Regenerative Medical Technology Empowers Burn Care: MEBO International Shines at the 2026 ABA Orlando Conference

items.title: MEBO International Debuts at Chile National Wound Foundation's First Wound Expo
items.excerpt: In Santiago, MEBO International joined more than 1,700 healthcare professionals and 40 international companies at the first expo of Chile's National Wound Foundation, introducing Moist Exposed Burn Ointment to the Chilean market.
items.image_alt: MEBO International Debuts at Chile National Wound Foundation's First Wound Expo

items.title: Regenerative Medical Technology Exchange in Peru Under the APEC Framework
items.excerpt: Over five days, a MEBO International delegation held exchange sessions for more than 100 healthcare professionals across four major Peruvian public hospitals — and received ANIQUEM's 'Best Partner' award for its contribution to local burn care.
items.image_alt: Regenerative Medical Technology Exchange in Peru Under the APEC Framework

items.title: MEBO International Participates in Argentina Wound Conference, Promoting Regenerative Medical Technology Across Latin America
items.excerpt: During five days in Buenos Aires, MEBO International visited the Hospital de Clínicas 'José de San Martín', researched chain pharmacies, and delivered two lectures on the wound microenvironment at the COMLHEI conference.
items.image_alt: MEBO International Participates in Argentina Wound Conference, Promoting Regenerative Medical Technology Across Latin America

items.title: Kevin Xu's APEC Keynote: Building a People-Centered Digital Healthcare Future
items.excerpt: Speaking at the APEC 2025 CEO Summit in Gyeongju, MEBO Chairman Kevin Xu called for cross-economy collaboration to build a connected, inclusive, and sustainable digital healthcare ecosystem — and highlighted the new 'Silver Healing, Community Care' initiative with CGI.
items.image_alt: Kevin Xu's APEC Keynote: Building a People-Centered Digital Healthcare Future

items.title: MEBO Group Delegation Attends APEC 2025 Opening in Gyeongju, South Korea
items.excerpt: As a Diamond Sponsor of APEC 2025 — the first APEC hosted by South Korea in twenty years — MEBO Group board members Kevin Xu and Li Li led a 20-member delegation to the opening ceremony and CEO Summit welcome dinner.
items.image_alt: MEBO Group Delegation Attends APEC 2025 Opening in Gyeongju, South Korea

items.title: APEC 2025 Opens in Gyeongju: MEBO Group's 20-Member Delegation Takes the Stage
items.excerpt: South Korea hosts APEC for the first time in twenty years, drawing nearly 2,000 attendees. Diamond Sponsor MEBO Group joined the opening ceremony and the CEO Summit welcome dinner, where Prime Minister Kim Min-seok met with board members Kevin Xu and Li Li.
items.image_alt: APEC 2025 Opens in Gyeongju: MEBO Group's 20-Member Delegation Takes the Stage

items.title: 2025 International Diabetic Lower Extremity Symposium: Global Experts Lead Innovation in Diabetic Foot Ulcer Care
items.excerpt: Hosted by ISRMWR in Bali and co-organized with the Indonesian General Surgeons Society and the National Rongxiang Xu Foundation, IDLES 2025 gathered more than 300 experts from over 20 countries — featuring a special APEC Dialogue session.
items.image_alt: 2025 International Diabetic Lower Extremity Symposium: Global Experts Lead Innovation in Diabetic Foot Ulcer Care

items.title: MEBO Group Board Representative Attends 58th Latin America and Caribbean Annual Conference
items.excerpt: At the U.S. Chamber of Commerce's 58th AACCLA annual conference in Washington, MEBO representative Dr. Tao Guoxin met Ecuadorian Foreign Minister Gabriela Sommerfeld and discussed the agenda of the upcoming 10th Summit of the Americas in the Dominican Republic.
items.image_alt: MEBO Group Board Representative Attends 58th Latin America and Caribbean Annual Conference

items.title: Silicon Valley Meets APEC Again: 2025 Forum to Be Held in Gyeongju, South Korea
items.excerpt: Co-hosted by the Bay Area Council and MEBO International, the 'Silicon Valley Meets APEC 2025 Forum' will convene on October 16 at The K Hotel Gyeongju under the theme 'AI Impact: Shaping the Future', releasing a special report on AI innovation and regulation.
items.image_alt: Silicon Valley Meets APEC Again: 2025 Forum to Be Held in Gyeongju, South Korea

items.title: MEBO Group Chairman Kevin Xu Announces New Global Health Initiative at CGI Health Working Group
items.excerpt: 'Silver Healing: Equitable Community Wound Care' will bring regenerative medical technology from clinical settings to community-level healthcare across 28 countries and regions from 2025 to 2028 — the latest milestone in a decade of MEBO-CGI partnership.
items.image_alt: MEBO Group Chairman Kevin Xu Announces New Global Health Initiative at CGI Health Working Group

items.title: Former APEC Host Committee Chair Kevin Xu Joins Panama Government Roundtable on Inter-American Connectivity and Innovation
items.excerpt: During UN General Assembly week in New York, Kevin Xu joined Panama's high-level roundtable 'Promoting Connectivity and Innovation for the Americas' — attended by President José Raúl Mulino — and proposed revitalizing Panama's humanitarian hub for disaster response across Latin America.
items.image_alt: Former APEC Host Committee Chair Kevin Xu Joins Panama Government Roundtable on Inter-American Connectivity and Innovation

items.title: MEBO Chairman Kevin Xu Attends the 2025 BRICS Business Forum
items.excerpt: Attending as a strategic partner of the forum and guest of COP30 President Ambassador André Corrêa do Lago, Kevin Xu met Malaysian Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim in Rio de Janeiro and agreed to continue dialogue at the APEC CEO Summit in South Korea this October.
items.image_alt: MEBO Chairman Kevin Xu Attends the 2025 BRICS Business Forum

items.title: MEBO Reopens the APEC 2025 Moment
items.excerpt: At the Beijing stop of the APEC 2025 CEO Summit global roadshow 'Bridging Asia-Pacific Development Prospects', Kevin Xu joined a high-level roundtable and MEBO Group signed on as a global sponsor of the Gyeongju summit.
items.image_alt: MEBO Reopens the APEC 2025 Moment

items.title: MEBO Group Becomes Strategic Partner of the BRICS Business Forum
items.excerpt: MEBO Group joins the 2025 BRICS Business Forum in Rio de Janeiro as a strategic partner, with Chairman Kevin Xu invited by COP30 President Ambassador André Corrêa do Lago to explore new drivers of global growth alongside political and business leaders.
items.image_alt: MEBO Group Becomes Strategic Partner of the BRICS Business Forum

items.title: A New Chapter for Regenerative Medical Technology in Latin America: Diabetic Foot Symposium Successfully Held
items.excerpt: The third session of the Latin America Regenerative Medical Technology Symposium series — co-organized with Peruvian partner Discontinental — covered diagnosis and treatment of diabetic foot at every stage.
items.image_alt: A New Chapter for Regenerative Medical Technology in Latin America: Diabetic Foot Symposium Successfully Held

items.title: The 35th EWMA Conference Convenes in Barcelona
items.excerpt: At EWMA 2025 in Barcelona — nearly 6,000 wound management experts from over 90 countries — MEBO International exhibited for the eighth consecutive year and co-hosted a regenerative medical technology symposium that also launched the European stop of the Regenerative Life Action global tour.
items.image_alt: The 35th EWMA Conference Convenes in Barcelona

items.title: Preview: The 2024 APEC CEO Summit Agenda
items.excerpt: From November 13–15 in Lima, Peru's third time hosting APEC will bring together leaders from 21 economies and more than 1,200 executives — with MEBO International CEO Kevin Xu joining the panel on aging populations, pandemics, and healthcare innovation.
items.image_alt: Preview: The 2024 APEC CEO Summit Agenda

items.title: Inside the APEC 2024 Official Gift Bag: Unique Design, Rich Culture
items.excerpt: Inspired by Peru's Rainbow Mountain, the APEC 2024 gift bag pairs alpaca craftsmanship with a friendship panda pin — and includes MEBO Moist Exposed Burn Ointment (Peru edition) as its only pharmaceutical item.
items.image_alt: Inside the APEC 2024 Official Gift Bag: Unique Design, Rich Culture

items.title: 2024 APEC Silicon Valley Summit and Regenerative Life Action Global Tour Launch in Peru, Opening APEC Leaders' Week
items.excerpt: Co-presented by the Bay Area Council and MEBO International, the 2024 APEC Silicon Valley Summit opened in Lima — where the Regenerative Life Action global tour also began its first stop, continuing a decade of humanitarian work across more than ten countries.
items.image_alt: 2024 APEC Silicon Valley Summit and Regenerative Life Action Global Tour Launch in Peru, Opening APEC Leaders' Week

items.title: Silicon Valley Wisdom Meets Asia-Pacific Strength: APEC 2024 Silicon Valley Summit Comes to Lima
items.excerpt: In a welcome video, MEBO Chairman and APEC 2023 Host Committee Chair Kevin Xu invites the world to the APEC 2024 Silicon Valley Summit in Lima on November 9, co-hosted by the Bay Area Council and MEBO International.
items.image_alt: Silicon Valley Wisdom Meets Asia-Pacific Strength: APEC 2024 Silicon Valley Summit Comes to Lima

items.title: PAPER Magazine Celebrates Its 40th Anniversary in Peru
items.excerpt: PAPER magazine — part of MEBO International's Street Media — marked four decades of pop-culture influence with a celebration in Lima during APEC 2024 host week, featuring an iconic cover exhibition from ROSÉ to Christina Aguilera.
items.image_alt: PAPER Magazine Celebrates Its 40th Anniversary in Peru

items.title: MEBO APEC 2024 in Action: In-Depth Hospital Visit in Peru Builds Consensus for a Healthier Future
items.excerpt: Following the Regenerative Life Action launch with ANIQUEM and the Latin America Forum, MEBO International visited Lambayeque Provincial Hospital in Chiclayo — where nearly 500 healthcare professionals, researchers, and students gathered for exchange.
items.image_alt: MEBO APEC 2024 in Action: In-Depth Hospital Visit in Peru Builds Consensus for a Healthier Future

items.title: MEBO APEC 2024 in Action: Latin America Forum Strengthens Regional Medical Cooperation
items.excerpt: Co-hosted by the International Society of Regenerative Medicine and Wound Repair and MEBO Group, the Lima forum brought together more than 150 healthcare professionals to advance regenerative wound care across Latin America.
items.image_alt: MEBO APEC 2024 in Action: Latin America Forum Strengthens Regional Medical Cooperation

items.title: MEBO APEC 2024 in Action: Partnering with ANIQUEM to Build a Bridge of Care for Children
items.excerpt: MEBO Group and Peruvian nonprofit ANIQUEM signed a cooperation agreement to provide comprehensive rehabilitation — physical, occupational, and psychological therapy plus custom pressure garments — for children in poverty who have suffered severe burns.
items.image_alt: MEBO APEC 2024 in Action: Partnering with ANIQUEM to Build a Bridge of Care for Children

items.title: 22nd ISBI Congress Successfully Held in Birmingham
items.excerpt: More than 1,000 burn care specialists from 47 countries gathered in Birmingham under the theme 'Facing the Future' — where MEBO International hosted the seminar 'Regenerative Medicine: The Future of Wound Management'.
items.image_alt: 22nd ISBI Congress Successfully Held in Birmingham

items.title: Former APEC Host Committee Chair Kevin Xu Holds In-Depth Talks with Peru's APEC SOM Chair Carlos Vásquez
items.excerpt: At Peru's Ministry of Foreign Affairs in Lima, Kevin Xu and 2024 APEC SOM Chair Carlos Vásquez discussed making APEC benefit broader communities — through a Silicon Valley forum, a Spanish-language magazine launch, regenerative medical training, and an APEC food week.
items.image_alt: Former APEC Host Committee Chair Kevin Xu Holds In-Depth Talks with Peru's APEC SOM Chair Carlos Vásquez

items.title: First Stop of APEC 2024 Activities: MEBO Group Visits ANIQUEM, Peru's Burned Children Rehabilitation Association
items.excerpt: Invited by Peru's APEC organizing committee COMEXPERU, a MEBO Group delegation visited ANIQUEM in Lima — Peru's only self-sustaining nonprofit offering free rehabilitation to burned children — to discuss donations, physician training, and child care programs.
items.image_alt: First Stop of APEC 2024 Activities: MEBO Group Visits ANIQUEM, Peru's Burned Children Rehabilitation Association

items.title: U.S. State Department Releases 2023 APEC Outcomes Report, Bay Area Council Activities Listed as Key Results
items.excerpt: The State Department's 2023 APEC outcomes report highlights the Bay Area Council's five-day APEC California and Silicon Valley conference aboard the historic Klamath — part of nearly 30 stakeholder initiatives that drew more than 3,000 senior officials and business leaders.
items.image_alt: U.S. State Department Releases 2023 APEC Outcomes Report, Bay Area Council Activities Listed as Key Results

items.title: APEC 2023 Co-Chair Kevin Xu Attends Peruvian President's Private Dinner to Discuss Peru's Upcoming APEC Host Year
items.excerpt: At a nearly three-hour private dinner hosted by Freeport Chairman Richard Adkerson, Kevin Xu exchanged San Francisco hosting experience with President Dina Boluarte and the incoming APEC and CEO Summit chairs as Peru prepares to take over the rotating chairmanship.
items.image_alt: APEC 2023 Co-Chair Kevin Xu Attends Peruvian President's Private Dinner to Discuss Peru's Upcoming APEC Host Year

items.title: 2023 International Diabetic Lower Extremity Symposium Held in Phuket, Thailand
items.excerpt: Making its Asian debut, IDLES 2023 gathered more than 200 medical professionals from 17 countries in Phuket — featuring an APEC session led by ISBI Treasurer and past ABA President Dr. Tina Palmieri.
items.image_alt: 2023 International Diabetic Lower Extremity Symposium Held in Phuket, Thailand

items.title: City of San Francisco Officially Announces Kevin Xu as APEC 2023 Host Committee Co-Chair
items.excerpt: Mayor London Breed announced Kevin Xu as a leading sponsor and Co-Chair of the APEC 2023 Host Committee, as the city recognized MEBO International's US$1 million contribution — the summit's first sponsorship.
items.image_alt: City of San Francisco Officially Announces Kevin Xu as APEC 2023 Host Committee Co-Chair

items.title: APEC 2023 Official Website Launches, with MEBO International Listed as a Key Partner
items.excerpt: As APEC 2023's official website goes live, MEBO International — a corporate partner and organizing committee member — launches the 'APEC 2023 Dialogue' interview series with the Marina Times and Entrepreneur to bring APEC closer to the public.
items.image_alt: APEC 2023 Official Website Launches, with MEBO International Listed as a Key Partner

items.title: MEBO International Joins Bay Area Council Working Session with U.S. Ambassadors to ASEAN
items.excerpt: MEBO International President Li Li met with the U.S. Ambassador to ASEAN and the ambassadors to Malaysia, the Philippines, and Vietnam at Bay Area Council headquarters to discuss preparations for APEC San Francisco — and found strong support for MEBO's ASEAN operations.
items.image_alt: MEBO International Joins Bay Area Council Working Session with U.S. Ambassadors to ASEAN

items.title: MEBO Chairman Kevin Xu Meets Mexico's Ambassador to the United States
items.excerpt: At Bay Area Council headquarters, Kevin Xu and CEO Jim Wunderman hosted Ambassador Esteban Moctezuma Barragán — discussing MEBO's burn clinical research project with Guadalajara's Civil Hospital and Mexico's preparations for APEC 2023.
items.image_alt: MEBO Chairman Kevin Xu Meets Mexico's Ambassador to the United States

items.title: MEBO Chairman Kevin Xu Meets Chile's Ambassador to the United States
items.excerpt: Kevin Xu and Bay Area Council CEO Jim Wunderman hosted Ambassador Juan Gabriel Valdés for APEC preparatory talks — where the Ambassador offered full support for bringing the CGI 'Regenerative Wave' physician training program to Chile.
items.image_alt: MEBO Chairman Kevin Xu Meets Chile's Ambassador to the United States

items.title: Regenerative Wave MEBT Training Delivers Results: Ecuadorian President Joins CGI 2022 Annual Meeting
items.excerpt: Ecuadorian President Guillermo Lasso attended the Clinton Global Initiative 2022 Annual Meeting as a speaker in recognition of the Regenerative Wave MEBT training program, whose first sessions trained more than 400 healthcare workers in Ecuador.
items.image_alt: Regenerative Wave MEBT Training Delivers Results: Ecuadorian President Joins CGI 2022 Annual Meeting

items.title: ISBI and ABA Join 'Mending Europe: Empowering the Establishment of a Regeneration Network' Initiative
items.excerpt: The International Society for Burn Injuries and the American Burn Association have joined the Clinton Global Initiative commitment launched by President Bill Clinton and MEBO Chairman Kevin Xu — with online training already delivered to more than 140 medical professionals from Bulgaria and Ukraine.
items.image_alt: ISBI and ABA Join 'Mending Europe: Empowering the Establishment of a Regeneration Network' Initiative

items.title: Business and Academic Exchange in Ecuador: MEBO International Sets Sail Again in Latin America
items.excerpt: During a week-long visit to Quito and Guayaquil, MEBO International and its partner Difare reviewed market strategy, exchanged the latest clinical data on scar ointment, and witnessed regenerative medical technology helping diabetic foot patients avoid amputation.
items.image_alt: Business and Academic Exchange in Ecuador: MEBO International Sets Sail Again in Latin America

items.title: MEBO International Restarts the Regenerative Wave in Latin America
items.excerpt: Honoring its 2019 Clinton Global Initiative commitment, MEBO International and partner Difare relaunched the Regenerative Wave training program in Ecuador — reaching 400 healthcare professionals, far beyond the original goal of 160.
items.image_alt: MEBO International Restarts the Regenerative Wave in Latin America

items.title: The 21st ISBI Congress: Vibrant Mexico, an Academic Feast, and a Journey of Original Aspiration
items.excerpt: At the first in-person ISBI Congress since the pandemic, held in Guadalajara, MEBO International — longtime platinum sponsor — drew global attention with a butterfly-inspired booth and held cooperation talks with ISBI leadership and UC Davis.
items.image_alt: The 21st ISBI Congress: Vibrant Mexico, an Academic Feast, and a Journey of Original Aspiration

items.title: MEBO Chairman Kevin Xu Meets Former Mexican President Ernesto Zedillo
items.excerpt: At the fifth Pearson Annual Forum at the University of Chicago, Kevin Xu and former Mexican President Ernesto Zedillo discussed the shortage of burn and wound specialists in Latin America and the CGI 'Regenerative Wave' training program for the Americas.
items.image_alt: MEBO Chairman Kevin Xu Meets Former Mexican President Ernesto Zedillo

items.title: MEBO Chairman Kevin Xu Attends the APEC CEO Summit
items.excerpt: Invited by New Zealand Prime Minister Jacinda Ardern, Kevin Xu joined the 2021 APEC CEO Summit, where Chinese President Xi Jinping delivered a keynote on sustainable development and an Asia-Pacific community with a shared future.
items.image_alt: MEBO Chairman Kevin Xu Attends the APEC CEO Summit

items.title: Regenerative Wave: MEBO International Launches a New Initiative for Latin America
items.excerpt: At the Clinton Foundation's CGI gathering, Hillary Clinton announced MEBO International's new training commitment for Latin America and the Caribbean — 'Regenerative Wave: MEBT Training in Latin America' — and presented Chairman Kevin Xu with the commitment certificate.
items.image_alt: Regenerative Wave: MEBO International Launches a New Initiative for Latin America

items.title: MEBO Chairman Kevin Xu Concludes Productive Working Visit to Panama
items.excerpt: Meetings with Panama's ministers of health and commerce, the children's hospital, the Colón Free Zone, and the Regional Humanitarian Assistance Center laid the groundwork for UN 'Every Woman Every Child' programs and a refugee relief network in Latin America.
items.image_alt: MEBO Chairman Kevin Xu Concludes Productive Working Visit to Panama

items.title: MEBO Chairman Kevin Xu Makes His First Official Visit to Panama
items.excerpt: On his first day in Panama, Kevin Xu met the Minister of Health and the President's medical adviser, lunched with the Chinese Ambassador, and visited the National Burn Care Association — laying the foundation for MEBO's public-welfare programs and market development in Latin America.
items.image_alt: MEBO Chairman Kevin Xu Makes His First Official Visit to Panama
